consequences: A receipt or changed token is not a cancelled terminal; committing races may still commit.
Internal shutdown may retain conversation-wide cancellation. Pre-start tombstones, Host/WebView timings and desktop receipt presentation remain open.
context: Installed Esc attempts lack a verified cancelled terminal. Code inspection found Gateway drops the authenticated turn ID and cancels only by conversation, allowing stale requests to affect a newer execution.
decision: Forward the exact turn identity for public cancellation and stream timeouts; coordinator matches conversation and turn under its lock. Store encrypted content-free runtime cancellation receipts separately from canonical client terminal events.
title: Bind cancellation to the requested turn and retain bounded receipts
